title: Yolo Club
tagline: Crypto Casino for Degens. Are you Bullish or Bearish? Put your money where your mouth is.
description:
Yolo Club is a Crypto Casino. As part of the ETH Global - HackFS hackathon, we created our first game - Bulls vs Bears.

In the Bulls vs Bears game, users can bet on an asset's price action at a future date. For MVP, users can bet on the prices of cryptocurrencies.

1. Create a betting pool. Every betting pool will deploy a new Smart Contract.
2. Users will now participate in the betting pool. Buying bull tickets if they agree with the statement or bear ticket if they disagree.
3. On the future date, price of the asset, in our case, the price of Ethereum is fetched from a reliable price API and eventually pricing oracle.
4. Winners are picked based on the price and the pool money is distributed equally to all winning tickets.
how_its_made:
Front End - Next JS, React
Betting Pool Details Storage - IPFS (To enable transparency)
Data Storage (Reference to IPFS CID and Betting Pool Smart Contract Address) - Air Table

Smart Contract language - Solidity, JavaScript
Framework - Web3. js
Packaging - Hardhat
Version Control - Github
